_comment: Generated by tools/extract/extract_score_monitors.py (docs/progress/score-monitors.md): the TV props of Arena's design scenes whose ArenaMonitorHolder shows a mode's timer, score or alive count. One row per holder of every scene the map imports. path = the PROP's hierarchy path (the holder's parent) inside scene (Equator's two DesignStuff scenes repeat the same paths), at = the holder's WORLD position in the scene data (the canvas centre; tells apart a path that repeats, and is checked against the loaded prop within 0.05 m). arena_type = the holder's type word; template = Arena's template for it (null when the word names none), confirmed = true for the words that Bowl's TIMER / SCORE / ALIVE prop names prove (0, 1, 2); face = what the port draws: timer, score (words 1 and 6), alive, or none (the prop stays dark). active_in_scene = the prop and all its ancestors are active in the scene data; only such a prop gets a screen. prop_scale = the prop's uniform world scale, world_size_m = the canvas in metres, viewer_yaw = the compass yaw (0 = +Z, 90 = +X) of the direction from the screen towards the reader (the canvas is readable from there; the canvas forward points the other way). mount = the pose every holder has below its prop (local position, rotation xyzw, uniform scale, rect in canvas pixels). ArenaMapRegistry.<Map>.ScoreMonitors mirrors scene, path, at, arena_type and active_in_scene number for number (validate_map_descriptors.py and ScoreMonitorSidecarTests). Object names and derived numbers only; no Arena asset or file is stored.
